category.rules:
• Eggs carried over from a previous world cannot be meaningfully used (Up-throwing all eggs at the start of the first level is acceptable)

• Using an item acquired outside of the world is not allowed

• Starting from a completed file is allowed

• Levels must be played in order (with the exception of the Extras category)

• Timing begins when selecting the first level on the map screen
